The connection slot is out of range: `slots=256` so valid slots are [0,255], but my generator used `"slot": (i if mode!="collide" else 0)` with nconn=2048 → slots up to 2047 > 255. That's a generator bug, not an implementation bug.

Let me fix the stress generator: slot = i % 256.

arguments.command: cd /workspace && sed -i 's|"slot":(i if mode!="collide" else 0)|"slot":(i%256 if mode!="collide" else 0)|' tmp/stress.py && python3 tmp/stress.py
